## 2024-05-23 - Modal Overlay Interactions
**Learning:** Tailwind utility classes like `pointer-events-none` and `opacity-0` are not automatically available if not generated by a build step. Modal overlays relying on these for click-through behavior blocked underlying UI when invisible.
**Action:** Always verify critical utility classes are present in `index.html` `<style>` block or CSS file when modifying UI components that rely on them.
